basic.name: 普通攻击：风花
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的斩击，前两段造成物理伤害，后三段造成烈霜伤害；
第五段[普通攻击]发动期间可以格挡敌人的攻击。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to five slashes ahead, the first two deal Physical DMG, and the last three deal Frost DMG.
Block enemy attacks during the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.

special.name: 特殊技：深雪
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
快速拔刀向前方进行斩击，造成烈霜伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly draws her blade and slashes ahead, dealing Frost DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：飞雪
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
快速突进，对路径上的敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量烈霜伤害；
招式发动时，获得2点[落霜]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
招式发动后，能量足够时，再次点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
额外消耗能量，对前方范围内的敌人发动强力追击，造成大量烈霜伤害；
招式发动时，获得2点[落霜]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Rush forward, unleashing powerful slashes against enemies along the way, dealing massive Frost DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 points of Fallen Frost.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] again to activate:
Consume extra Energy and unleash a powerful follow-up attack against enemies in front, dealing massive Frost DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 points of Fallen Frost.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：寒雀
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成烈霜伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Frost DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：春临
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量烈霜伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Frost DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：名残雪
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力斩击，略作延迟后发动终结一击，造成大量烈霜伤害；

ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies ahead in a large area then pauses, before unleashing a Finishing Move, dealing massive Frost DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gain 3 points of Fallen Frost and increase Ice DMG by 30% for 12s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text:
星见雅对敌人造成烈霜伤害时，将会为目标附着[冰焰]，持续30秒；对附着[冰焰]的敌人累积烈霜异常积蓄值时，会基于星见雅暴击率的100%提升烈霜异常积蓄效率，最多提升80%；星见雅累积烈霜异常积蓄值时，具有独立的属性异常积蓄槽，随之触发的[冻结]、[碎冰]和[霜寒]效果，可以与包括冰属性异常效果在内的其他属性异常效果互相结算[紊乱]；
星见雅对附着[冰焰]的敌人施加[霜寒]效果时，将会消除[冰焰]并触发[霜灼·破]，对目标造成星见雅1500%攻击力的烈霜伤害，同时使目标进入[霜灼]状态；[霜灼]状态下，所有单位对目标累积的属性异常积蓄值提升20%，但星见雅无法再次为其附着[冰焰]；[霜灼]状态将会随本次[霜寒]效果一起结束，状态持续期间，对敌人重新施加属性异常效果可以覆盖[霜寒]并消除[霜灼]；
触发[霜灼·破]时，星见雅获得1点[落霜]，10秒内最多触发一次。
facts.textEn:
When Hoshimi Miyabi deals Frost DMG, she applies Icefire to the target, lasting 30s. When accumulating Frost Anomaly Buildup against targets with Icefire, increases Frost Anomaly Buildup Rate by 100% of Hoshimi Miyabi's CRIT Rate, up to a maximum increase of 80%. As Hoshimi Miyabi accumulates Frost Anomaly Buildup, it has its own independent Attribute Anomaly Buildup gauge and triggers Freeze, Shatter, and Frostbite that can react with other Attribute Anomalies, including Ice Attribute Anomaly, to trigger Disorder.
When Hoshimi Miyabi applies Frostbite to enemies with Icefire, it will consume the Icefire to trigger Frostburn - Break, dealing Frost DMG equal to 1,500% of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK and causing the target to enter the Frostburn state. All units accumulate 20% more Anomaly Buildup against enemies under the Frostburn state, but Hoshimi Miyabi cannot reapply Icefire to these enemies. The Frostburn state ends when Frostbite expires. While this state remains active, triggering another Attribute Anomaly will overwrite Frostbite and remove Frostburn.
Upon triggering Frostburn - Break, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains 1 point of Fallen Frost. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

cinema.name: 雪上加霜
cinema.description: 在[霜月架势]期间，每消耗1点[落霜]，[普通攻击：霜月]将无视目标6%防御力，最多叠加6层，退出[霜月架势]后增益效果结束；在[普通攻击：霜月]中进行三段蓄力，斩击命中处于[霜灼]状态下的敌人时，可以立即消除目标的[霜灼]状态，并使全队角色属性异常积蓄效率提升20%，持续10秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in Shimotsuki Stance, every 1 point of Fallen Frost consumed will allow Basic Attack: Shimotsuki to ignore 6% of DEF, stacking up to 6 times and lasting until Shimotsuki Stance ends. When the slash for charge level three of Basic Attack: Shimotsuki hits an enemy under Frostburn, it will immediately remove the Frostburn state and increase all squad members' Anomaly Buildup Rate by 20% for 10s.

cinema.name: 吐纳法
cinema.description: [普通攻击：风花]和[闪避反击]造成的伤害提升30%；第五段[普通攻击：风花]最后一击命中敌人时，星见雅获得1点[落霜]；进入战场时，星见雅立刻获得6点[落霜]，自身暴击率提升15%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack: Kazahana and Dodge Counter DMG increases by 30%. Hoshimi Miyabi gains 1 point of Fallen Frost when the final move of the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Kazahana hits an enemy. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 6 points of Fallen Frost and her CRIT Rate increases by 15%.

cinema.name: 武者修养
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 皲裂
cinema.description: [霜灼·破]造成的伤害提升30%，触发[霜灼·破]时，星见雅额外获得250点喧响值。
cinema.descriptionEn: Frostburn - Break DMG increases by 30%. Upon triggering Frostburn - Break, Hoshimi Miyabi generates 250 more Decibels.

cinema.name: 纪念日
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 天资卓越
cinema.description: 在[霜月架势]期间，星见雅将获得[极意]效果，使[普通攻击：霜月]造成的伤害提升30%，获得[极意]效果后，消耗[落霜]时，星见雅会根据当前蓄力段数，自动拔刀向前方发动强力斩击；在[落霜]耗尽前，拔刀斩击不会打断[霜月架势]下的蓄力进度；在一次[霜月架势]期间，最多连续发动3次拔刀斩击。
cinema.descriptionEn: During Shimotsuki Stance, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains Polar, which increases Basic Attack: Shimotsuki DMG by 30%. After obtaining Polar, Hoshimi Miyabi will automatically draw her blade and unleash powerful slashes based on the current charge level upon consuming Fallen Frost. Before Fallen Frost is completely depleted, the draw and slashes will not interrupt charging under Shimotsuki Stance. Each occurrence of Shimotsuki Stance can perform up to 3 draws and slashes.

星见雅收刀进入[霜月架势]并开始蓄力，每段蓄力会消耗2点[落霜]，最多可以进行三段蓄力，松开 【普通攻击键】 或[落霜]耗尽时，星见雅将根据当前蓄力段数，拔刀向前方发动强力斩击，造成大量烈霜伤害，随后退出[霜月架势]；

basic.descriptionEn:
With at least 2 points of Fallen Frost, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Hoshimi Miyabi sheaths her blade, enters Shimotsuki Stance and starts to charge up. Every level of charge will consume 2 points of Fallen Frost, up to a maximum of three levels of charge.
When releasing [Basic Attack], or when Fallen Frost is completely depleted, Hoshimi Miyabi will draw her blade and unleash a powerful slash ahead based on the current charge level, dealing massive Frost DMG. She then exits Shimotsuki Stance.
Character is invulnerable during Shimotsuki Stance.
Hoshimi Miyabi can have up to 6 points of Fallen Frost. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 3 points of Fallen Frost.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

109100001.name: 普通攻击：风花
109100001.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的斩击，前两段造成物理伤害，后三段造成烈霜伤害；
第五段[普通攻击]发动期间可以格挡敌人的攻击。
109100001.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to five slashes ahead, the first two deal Physical DMG, and the last three deal Frost DMG.
Block enemy attacks during the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.

109100002.name: 普通攻击：霜月
109100002.description:
拥有2点或以上[落霜]时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
星见雅收刀进入[霜月架势]并开始蓄力，每段蓄力会消耗2点[落霜]，最多可以进行三段蓄力，松开 【普通攻击键】 或[落霜]耗尽时，星见雅将根据当前蓄力段数，拔刀向前方发动强力斩击，造成大量烈霜伤害，随后退出[霜月架势]；
[霜月架势]期间拥有无敌效果；
星见雅最多拥有6点[落霜]，进入战场时，星见雅立刻获得3点[落霜]。
109100002.descriptionEn:
With at least 2 points of Fallen Frost, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Hoshimi Miyabi sheaths her blade, enters Shimotsuki Stance and starts to charge up. Every level of charge will consume 2 points of Fallen Frost, up to a maximum of three levels of charge.
When releasing [Basic Attack], or when Fallen Frost is completely depleted, Hoshimi Miyabi will draw her blade and unleash a powerful slash ahead based on the current charge level, dealing massive Frost DMG. She then exits Shimotsuki Stance.
Character is invulnerable during Shimotsuki Stance.
Hoshimi Miyabi can have up to 6 points of Fallen Frost. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 3 points of Fallen Frost.

109100004.name: 强化特殊技：飞雪
109100004.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
快速突进，对路径上的敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量烈霜伤害；
招式发动时，获得2点[落霜]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
招式发动后，能量足够时，再次点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
额外消耗能量，对前方范围内的敌人发动强力追击，造成大量烈霜伤害；
招式发动时，获得2点[落霜]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
109100004.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Rush forward, unleashing powerful slashes against enemies along the way, dealing massive Frost DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 points of Fallen Frost.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] again to activate:
Consume extra Energy and unleash a powerful follow-up attack against enemies in front, dealing massive Frost DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 points of Fallen Frost.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

109100008.name: 连携技：春临
109100008.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力斩击，造成大量烈霜伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
109100008.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Frost DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

109100009.name: 终结技：名残雪
109100009.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力斩击，略作延迟后发动终结一击，造成大量烈霜伤害；
招式发动时，获得3点[落霜]，自身造成的冰属性伤害提升30%，持续12秒；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
109100009.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies ahead in a large area then pauses, before unleashing a Finishing Move, dealing massive Frost DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gain 3 points of Fallen Frost and increase Ice DMG by 30% for 12s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

109100011.name: 快速支援：花信风
109100011.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成烈霜伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
109100011.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Frost DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
